summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py and added tests/test_concurrency.py (10 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src). The venv's editable install resolves textual to the shared base tree, so PYTHONPATH was needed to test the change. Full non-snapshot suite (excluding cli and devtools, which need aiohttp) shows the same 68 pre-existing failures as the untouched base source, caused by missing async test support. Nothing was committed.
